entry.name: The egress test checks each shape's marker in its own turn
entry.expected: With each of rules 1-9 taken out of redact() in crates/terminus-core/src/observe/egress.rs in turn, and separately the apply_record call at crates/terminus-core/src/recall/excerpt.rs:227, `cargo test -p terminus-core --all-features --locked --test egress` fails and the message names a row of that rule's marker (for the keyed step, a keyed row's window turn); restored, it passes. The per-turn check itself is already verified (truth 4).
entry.why_human: Not human-only. It is runnable and was not exercised here: each removal edits the tree and rebuilds, which is outside this verifier's no-mutation rule and its ~10-second spot-check bound. Run it in a scratch copy or worktree, not by asking.
